title: Ear and Harmony Path
subtitle: Eleven levels from hearing home to whole songs by ear: ear training and the harmony of songs, interleaved, with a song shelf at every level.
benchmark: Trinity and RSL Rock and Pop aural, grades 6 to 8; ABRSM aural to grade 6; Berklee Harmony 1 to 3

levels.title: Home
levels.goal: Hear where home is in any song, sing and find degrees 1 to 5, echo simple rhythms, play a first melody and a riff by ear.
levels.adds: Ear: the tonic, degrees 1 to 5, echoed rhythms, riffs. Harmony: the major scale and the keys near C (Circle T-1, T-2).

steps.title: Anchor the tonic
steps.setup: Scale degrees 1 and 5: listen along first, then hum the tonic (the home note) and answer. The I-IV-V-I cadence that keeps the key for 8 questions waits for N1.
steps.done: Hum the tonic after the cadence; the app check 80% over 20 items, on two days.

steps.title: Degrees 1 to 5
steps.setup: Scale degrees, choice, major pentachord. The resolution to the tonic after each answer waits for N1.
steps.done: 80% over 20 items, on two days.

steps.title: Sing or play them back
steps.setup: Scale degrees, major pentachord: play each one back, then sing it.
steps.done: 75% of notes played back and sung, the voice within 50 cents, on two days.

steps.title: Echo a rhythm
steps.setup: Rhythm, echo: quarters and eighths.
steps.done: 80% of patterns with every onset in the window, on two days.
steps.feeds: Seven Nation Army, Smoke on the Water

steps.title: Find home in a real song
steps.setup: Learn by ear, Find home: load a shelf song you own, listen, then play, sing or pick the note that sounds like home. It is checked against the key the whole recording points to.
steps.done: Tonic right first try on 4 of 5 shelf songs.

steps.title: H1 The major scale
steps.setup: Library reference (scales), then Scales on your instrument: C, G, F and D major.
steps.done: Whole and half step pattern recited; four scales clean at 72 BPM twice, on two days.

steps.title: Circle T-1 and T-2
steps.setup: Circle: the order of sharps and flats, then signatures for C, G and F, then up to 2 sharps or flats.
steps.done: 95% under 2 seconds over 20 items, on two days.

steps.title: First melody by ear
steps.setup: The shelf loop on a melody; check it in Phrases (Ode to Joy is built in) or against the score in Song Studio.
steps.done: Two shelf melodies played through, at most 2 wrong notes each.
steps.feeds: Ode to Joy, Saints, Jingle Bells

steps.title: First riff by ear
steps.setup: The shelf loop on a riff, one string or one hand.
steps.done: Riff in time with the record, four times clean.
steps.feeds: Seven Nation Army, Smoke on the Water, Another One Bites the Dust

steps.title: Sing the tonic of anything
steps.setup: Any song you hear during the day: hum home, then check it in Learn by ear, Find home, with the recording. Every check goes in the journal.
steps.done: 10 songs logged in the journal, 8 right.

shelf.title: Ode to Joy
shelf.teaches: Melody: steps on 1 to 5, one leap to low 5
shelf.detail: C or D, 100 BPM, I and V

fallback.label: In the app: Phrases, Ode to Joy (public domain)

shelf.title: When the Saints Go Marching In
shelf.teaches: Melody: the 1-3-4-5 pickup motif; sing, then play
shelf.detail: F, 110 BPM (cut time), I IV V

shelf.title: Jingle Bells
shelf.teaches: Melody: repeated 3s, then 3-5-1-2-3
shelf.detail: G or C, 120 BPM, I IV V7

fallback.label: In the app: Phrases, Jingle Bells (public domain)

shelf.title: Happy Birthday
shelf.teaches: Melody in 3/4, the octave leap 5 to high 5
shelf.detail: F or C, 3/4, I V7 IV

fallback.label: In the app: Phrases, Happy Birthday (public domain since 2016 in the US)

shelf.title: Lean on Me
shelf.teaches: Melody: stepwise 1-2-3-4 and back; I to IV by ear
shelf.detail: C, 76 BPM, I IV I V

shelf.title: Seven Nation Army
shelf.teaches: Riff on one string: 1-1-b3-1-b7-b6-5; find home in a minor riff

shelf.title: Smoke on the Water
shelf.teaches: Riff in parallel fourths: 1-b3-4, 1-b3-b5-4

shelf.title: Another One Bites the Dust
shelf.teaches: Bass riff with sixteenth pickups; roots and b3

levels.test: Sing and then play two shelf melodies from memory (at most 2 slips), play one riff with the recording at full speed, and pass Scale degrees at the major pentachord level at 85% on a fresh day.

levels.title: Three chords
levels.goal: All seven major degrees in context, short melodies with rhythm, hear I, IV and V and follow their roots.
levels.adds: Ear: all seven degrees, the wrong note, short melodies, I IV V, roots. Harmony: triads on each degree, function, cadences.

steps.title: All seven degrees
steps.setup: Scale degrees, choice, major diatonic. The cadence and key context wait for N1.
steps.done: 80% over 20 items, on two days.

steps.title: Sing them back
steps.setup: Scale degrees, sing it, major diatonic.
steps.done: 75% of notes in the window, on two days.

steps.title: Spot the wrong note
steps.setup: Spot the wrong note: major pentachord, then major diatonic.
steps.done: 80% on each, on two days.

steps.title: Short melodies
steps.setup: Melody dictation, play back, major diatonic: three and four note phrases. One and two bar phrases with rhythm wait for N5.
steps.done: 75% per note, half the items fully right, on two days.

steps.title: Echo and write rhythms
steps.setup: Rhythm, echo, then dictation: rests and halves.
steps.done: Echo 80%; dictation 75% per note, on two days.

steps.title: H2 Triads on every degree
steps.setup: Library reference, then Circle, a key's chords, up to 2 sharps or flats. Numeral this chord waits for N7.
steps.done: Quality pattern (Maj min min Maj Maj min dim) recited; the chords of C, G, D, F, A and Bb named under 5 seconds, 95%.

steps.title: H3 Function and cadences
steps.setup: Cadences: authentic, plagal and half; Library reference.
steps.done: Cadences 80% over 20 items, on two days.
steps.feeds: Twist and Shout (V at the end of each line)

steps.title: Major or minor chord
steps.setup: Chord qualities: major and minor.
steps.done: 80%, on two days.

steps.title: Hear I, IV and V in a key
steps.setup: Chords in a key: I, IV and V.
steps.done: 80% over 20 items, on two days.

steps.title: Follow the bass: roots 1, 4, 5
steps.setup: Bass lines: roots on 1, 4 and 5.
steps.done: 75%, on two days.

steps.title: I, IV, V progressions
steps.setup: Progression dictation: I, IV and V.
steps.done: 75%, on two days.

steps.title: Circle T-3, up to four
steps.setup: Circle, signatures: up to 4 sharps or flats.
steps.done: 95% under 2 seconds, on two days.

steps.title: Chords of a three-chord song
steps.setup: The shelf loop for chords: hum the bass, test I, IV or V each bar, write numerals.
steps.done: Chords per bar 90% right on two songs.

steps.title: Melody with its rhythm
steps.setup: The shelf loop for a melody: write 8 bars with rhythm and compare with the score in Song Studio. The check against the score (N3) is still to come.
steps.done: 85% of notes and rhythms against the score.
steps.feeds: Amazing Grace, Auld Lang Syne, Leaving on a Jet Plane

shelf.title: Amazing Grace
shelf.teaches: Melody in 3/4, major pentatonic; then the chords
shelf.detail: G or F, 3/4, 72 BPM, I IV V

shelf.title: Auld Lang Syne
shelf.teaches: Pentatonic melody with a dotted rhythm; I V IV

shelf.title: La Bamba
shelf.teaches: The I-IV-V loop and the riff
shelf.detail: C, 150 BPM, I IV V loop

shelf.title: Twist and Shout
shelf.teaches: I-IV-V loop; the rising 5-6-7-8 vocal stack on V

shelf.title: Three Little Birds
shelf.teaches: I-IV-I-V; the offbeat skank; the bass line

shelf.title: Bad Moon Rising
shelf.teaches: I-V-IV-I verse, IV-I-V-I chorus; the melody

shelf.title: Wild Thing
shelf.teaches: I-IV-V-IV, the most famous three-chord riff

shelf.title: Brown Eyed Girl
shelf.teaches: I-IV-I-V verse; the guitar intro riff; vi appears in the chorus

shelf.title: Leaving on a Jet Plane
shelf.teaches: Melody with long held notes; I-IV and V

levels.test: From the recording alone, write the melody (8 bars, with rhythm) and chords of one shelf song at 85% against the score and play both; name I, IV or V for every bar of a second song you have not prepared; Progression dictation with I, IV and V at 80% on a fresh day.

levels.title: The pop loops
levels.goal: Hear vi, recognise the four-chord loops and their rotations, follow roots on 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, and pick the bass out of a mix.
levels.adds: Ear: vi, the four loops, roots on 1 2 4 5 6, the bass in the mix. Harmony: the relative minor, rotations of one loop.

steps.title: Chords in a key with vi
steps.setup: Chords in a key: I, IV, V and vi.
steps.done: 75% over 20 items, on two days.

steps.title: Song loops by ear
steps.setup: Song loops, pop: I-V-vi-IV, I-vi-IV-V, vi-IV-I-V, I-IV-V-IV and I-IV-vi-V played as a groove with bass and drums after the key is set. Then the song loops set, real songs' chords.
steps.done: Loop named first try, 80%, on two days.

steps.title: Roots on 1, 2, 4, 5, 6
steps.setup: Bass lines: roots on 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6.
steps.done: 75%, on two days.

steps.title: H4 The relative minor
steps.setup: Circle T-5: neighbours up to four, then signatures up to four with the minor keys.
steps.done: 95% under 2 seconds, on two days.

steps.title: H5 One loop, four rotations
steps.setup: Library reference, then Jam with the pop axis in C, G and D: play the loop starting on each chord.
steps.done: Loop played in three keys along Jam, two choruses each, no lost place.
steps.feeds: Let It Be, No Woman, No Cry, Don't Stop Believin'

steps.title: Hear the low band (Studio S-1, S-2)
steps.setup: Studio ears, find the boost: three bands on pink noise, then five.
steps.done: Studio S-1 (90% on three bands) and S-2 (80% on five), on two days.

steps.title: Bands on loops (Studio S-3)
steps.setup: Studio ears, find the boost: nine bands on the drum loop, then the band loop.
steps.done: Studio S-3: 70% on nine bands over a loop, on two days.

steps.title: Two-bar melodies with rhythm
steps.setup: Call and response, Echo: two-bar calls; sing first, then play back. The calls are made up over a groove, not taken from real tunes.
steps.done: 75% per note and onset.

steps.title: Dotted rhythms
steps.setup: Rhythm, echo, then dictation: dotted.
steps.done: Echo 80%, dictation 75%, on two days.

steps.title: Transcribe a loop and its bass
steps.setup: The shelf loop for chords and bass, in Learn by ear: loop it, slow it down and play it back. The check against the score (N3) is still to come.
steps.done: Two songs: loop and bass roots right for every bar.

steps.title: Transcribe a chorus melody
steps.setup: The shelf loop, 8 to 16 bars, compared with the score.
steps.done: 85% of notes and rhythms.
steps.feeds: Let It Be, Someone Like You, Hallelujah

steps.title: Sing roots while you play
steps.setup: Ear, Bass lines, Sing it: sing each root after the 1 once the key is set. Play the loop on your instrument before and after; singing while you play is not graded yet.
steps.done: Two choruses, roots in tune within 50 cents, 75%.

steps.title: Write over a loop
steps.setup: Create, the piano roll with a preset progression: an 8-bar melody over I-V-vi-IV that ends on 1.
steps.done: Saved; every strong-beat note a chord tone (a self-check until N10).

shelf.title: Let It Be
shelf.teaches: I-V-vi-IV verse; the IV-I/3 walk-down; the chorus melody

shelf.title: Stand by Me
shelf.teaches: I-vi-IV-V bass riff; sing the roots

shelf.title: No Woman, No Cry
shelf.teaches: I-V-vi-IV as one loop; organ fills

shelf.title: With or Without You
shelf.teaches: I-V-vi-IV over a pedal-like bass: hear the bass move D-A-B-G

shelf.title: Someone Like You
shelf.teaches: I-V-vi-IV with I/3; the leaps in the chorus melody

shelf.title: Perfect
shelf.teaches: I-vi-IV-V in 6/8 (a 12/8 feel)
shelf.detail: Ab (lead sheet in G or C), 63 BPM

shelf.title: Take Me Home, Country Roads
shelf.teaches: Verse I-vi-V-IV, chorus I-V-vi-IV: two rotations in one song

shelf.title: Riptide
shelf.teaches: vi-V-I loop (Am G C): hear vi as the start

shelf.title: Don't Stop Believin'
shelf.teaches: I-V-vi-IV piano riff; the chorus arrives late (form)

shelf.title: Hallelujah
shelf.teaches: 'The fourth, the fifth, the minor fall, the major lift': hear IV, V, vi, IV as the lyric names them

levels.test: Name the loop of five shelf or new songs from the recording, first try, 4 of 5; transcribe one chorus (melody, bass roots, chords) at 85% against the score and play it with the record; Chords in a key with I, IV, V and vi at 80%.

levels.title: The blues
levels.goal: Hear the 12-bar form, the dominant 7, the blues scale and blue notes, swing, and start call and response.
levels.adds: Ear: dominant 7, the blues scale, blue notes, swing, call and response. Harmony: the 12-bar form, I7 IV7 V7, minor pentatonic over a major blues.

steps.title: H6 The 12-bar blues
steps.setup: Library reference, then Jam in Check, Make the changes, blues: A and E (guitar, ukulele), C and F (piano), Bb and F concert (Aerophone).
steps.done: Three choruses along Jam without losing the form.

steps.title: Dominant 7 by ear
steps.setup: Chord qualities: major, minor and dominant 7.
steps.done: 80%, on two days.

steps.title: Pentatonic and blues scales
steps.setup: Scales and modes: major pentatonic, minor pentatonic and blues.
steps.done: 80%, on two days.
steps.feeds: C Jam Blues, Pride and Joy

steps.title: Blue notes in context
steps.setup: Scale degrees, chromatic colour, judged on b3 and b7. Narrowing the set to b3 and b7 waits for N1 (chosen degrees).
steps.done: 80% on b3 and b7, on two days.

steps.title: Swing and shuffle
steps.setup: Rhythm, echo: swing, then compound; then dictation.
steps.done: Echo 80% on swing and compound, on two days; dictation 75%.
steps.feeds: Pride and Joy, Folsom Prison Blues

steps.title: Count the form
steps.setup: Learn by ear: mark each chord change of a 12-bar blues (the Change mark) on 3 recordings, then loop each change to check it. The app keeps your marks; it can't judge them.
steps.done: Every change within a beat; quick change heard or not, right on 3 songs.

steps.title: Call: echo a blues lick
steps.setup: Phrases: the piano C blues lick or the guitar A blues lick, then Licks; then one-bar calls over a blues in Call and response, Echo.
steps.done: 75% of echoes graded right over 12 calls.

steps.title: Response: answer the call
steps.setup: Call and response, Answer, over the 12-bar blues: answer each call in the bars after it, on the grid, and land on a chord tone. Checked runs of 6 turns; the take is kept.
steps.done: 12 answers kept, 75% end on a chord tone in time.

steps.title: Circle T-3 and T-4
steps.setup: Circle: signatures for all 15 keys, then read them on the staff, treble up to four, then all keys in both clefs.
steps.done: 95% under 2 seconds (count) and under 3 seconds (staff), on two days.

steps.title: Transcribe a blues head
steps.setup: The shelf loop; write it with rhythm and compare with the score.
steps.done: 85% of notes and rhythms; play it with the record.

steps.title: Transcribe a riff or boogie bass
steps.setup: The shelf loop on a riff or a boogie bass.
steps.done: Riff or bass for a full chorus, played with the record.
steps.feeds: Sunshine of Your Love, Johnny B. Goode, Hound Dog

shelf.title: C Jam Blues
shelf.teaches: A head of two notes over a 12-bar: the first blues head by ear

shelf.title: Hound Dog
shelf.teaches: 12-bar form, stop-time; the melody on 1, b3, 4, 5

shelf.title: Folsom Prison Blues
shelf.teaches: Boom-chuck bass on 1 and 5; a 12-bar-like verse

shelf.title: Johnny B. Goode
shelf.teaches: 12-bar I-IV-V; the double-stop intro (guitar)

shelf.title: Sweet Home Chicago
shelf.teaches: Shuffle, quick change, turnaround

shelf.title: Tenor Madness
shelf.teaches: A jazz blues head; I7 IV7 with a ii-V turnaround

shelf.title: Sunshine of Your Love
shelf.teaches: Blues-scale riff: 1-1-b7-1-5-b5-4-1

shelf.title: Pride and Joy
shelf.teaches: Shuffle riff and quick change; the boogie bass

levels.test: Say quick change or not, and where the turnaround is, on three blues recordings; play one transcribed head and one riff with the record; three choruses of call and response over a Jam blues with 75% of echoes right and answers kept.

levels.title: Minor keys
levels.goal: Hear minor tonality, its degrees and chords, the raised 7 of harmonic minor, and interval size.
levels.adds: Ear: minor degrees and chords, harmonic minor, interval size. Harmony: natural, harmonic and melodic minor; relative and parallel minor; i iv V, VI VII, the Andalusian cadence.

steps.title: Minor degrees
steps.setup: Scale degrees, choice, minor diatonic. The i-iv-V-i cadence waits for N1.
steps.done: 75% over 20 items, on two days.

steps.title: Major, minor, harmonic minor
steps.setup: Scales and modes: major and natural minor, then add harmonic minor.
steps.done: 80%, on two days.

steps.title: H7 The minor key
steps.setup: Library reference; Scales: natural, harmonic and melodic minor in A, E and D; Circle T-5, minor signatures.
steps.done: Natural, harmonic and melodic forms played in A, E and D minor; 95% on minor keys under 2 seconds, on two days.

steps.title: Chords in a minor key
steps.setup: Chords in a key, minor: i, iv and V, then add VI and VII.
steps.done: 75%, on two days.

steps.title: Minor progressions
steps.setup: Progression dictation, minor: i, iv and V. Then the minor loops (i-bVII-bVI-V, i-iv-v, i-bVI-bIII-bVII) in Song loops.
steps.done: 75%, on two days.

steps.title: Minor melodies and wrong notes
steps.setup: Melody dictation, minor diatonic, then Spot the wrong note, minor diatonic.
steps.done: 75% per note in dictation; 80% on the wrong note, on two days.

steps.title: Hear interval size
steps.setup: Interval comparison: which of two intervals is bigger.
steps.done: 80%, on two days.

steps.title: Sixteenths
steps.setup: Rhythm, echo, then dictation: sixteenths.
steps.done: Echo 80%, dictation 75%, on two days.

steps.title: Transcribe a minor melody
steps.setup: The shelf loop, 16 bars, compared with the score.
steps.done: 85% of notes and rhythms.

steps.title: Transcribe a minor progression and bass
steps.setup: The shelf loop for chords and bass.
steps.done: Chords and bass right for every bar of a verse.
steps.feeds: House of the Rising Sun, Hit the Road Jack

steps.title: Call and response in minor
steps.setup: Call and response, Answer, over the minor ii-V-i. Checked runs of 6 turns; the take is kept.
steps.done: 12 answers, 75% end on a chord tone.

shelf.title: Ain't No Sunshine
shelf.teaches: Am-Em-G-Am: i-v-VII; the repeated 'I know' line

shelf.title: Hit the Road Jack
shelf.teaches: Andalusian i-VII-VI-V, the bass walks down; call and response vocals

shelf.title: Bella Ciao
shelf.teaches: Minor melody with V7 (harmonic minor); i-iv-V7

shelf.title: Zombie
shelf.teaches: Em-C-G-D: hear it as i-VI-III-VII, not I-V-vi-IV

shelf.title: Greensleeves
shelf.teaches: Minor melody with a raised 6 and 7; 3/4 (6/8)

fallback.label: In the app: Phrases, Greensleeves on piano (public domain)

shelf.title: House of the Rising Sun
shelf.teaches: i-III-IV-VI, i-III-V: the major V and major IV in minor; arpeggio bass

shelf.title: Summertime
shelf.teaches: Minor blues-tinged melody, i6-iv6, V7
shelf.detail: A or D minor, slow swing

shelf.title: Rolling in the Deep
shelf.teaches: i-v-VII then VI-VII-i; a sixteenth-note vocal rhythm

levels.test: Say major or minor for 10 recordings (9 right); transcribe one minor melody and one minor progression at 85%; hear the Andalusian cadence in a new song.

levels.title: Borrowed chords and Mixolydian rock
levels.goal: Hear the chromatic degrees, the borrowed chords bVII, bVI, iv and bIII, and name intervals as vocabulary.
levels.adds: Ear: chromatic degrees, bVII bVI iv, intervals named and sung. Harmony: modal interchange, Mixolydian rock, the minor iv in a major key.

steps.title: Chromatic colour
steps.setup: Scale degrees, choice, chromatic colour: judged on the chromatic degrees.
steps.done: 66% (many choices), on two days.

steps.title: H8 Borrowed chords
steps.setup: Library reference, then Circle of fifths, Spot the borrowed chord: a written progression in a key, pick the chord from the parallel minor (iv, bVI, bVII, bIII). Keys to two sharps or flats; a run is 20 progressions.
steps.done: 90% on 20 progressions.

steps.title: Hear bVII, bVI and iv
steps.setup: Song loops, borrowed chords: bVII, bVI, iv and bIII beside I, IV, V and vi, each in a short loop after the key is set (heard in a loop, not as a single chord in Chords in a key).

steps.title: Rock loops by ear
steps.setup: Song loops, rock: I-bVII-IV, I-bVII-IV-I, i-bVII-bVI-bVII, i-bVII-bVI-V and I-III-IV-iv, played as a groove.
steps.done: Named first try, 80%.
steps.feeds: Sweet Home Alabama, All Along the Watchtower

steps.title: Name intervals, a few at a time
steps.setup: Intervals: M3 P5 P8, then P1 P4 P5 P8, then m3 M3 m6 M6, then all twelve.
steps.done: 66% per set, then all twelve, on two days.

steps.title: Sing intervals back
steps.setup: Intervals, sing it: M3, P5 and P8. Warm up on Fine pitch from 50 cents.
steps.done: 75% in the window, on two days.

steps.title: Major, Lydian, Mixolydian
steps.setup: Scales and modes: major, Lydian and Mixolydian.
steps.done: 80%, on two days.

steps.title: Syncopation
steps.setup: Rhythm, echo, then dictation: syncopation.
steps.done: Echo 80%, dictation 75%, on two days.

steps.title: Find the cut (Studio S-4, S-5)
steps.setup: Studio ears: find the cut on nine bands, then smaller boosts (6 dB) on the drum loop.
steps.done: Studio S-4 and S-5: 70% on nine bands, on two days.

steps.title: Transcribe chords with a borrowed chord
steps.setup: The shelf loop for chords, compared with the score.
steps.done: Every bar right, the borrowed chord named.
steps.feeds: Creep, Hey Jude, Don't Look Back in Anger

steps.title: Transcribe a melody with chromatic notes
steps.setup: The shelf loop on a melody.
steps.done: 85% of notes and rhythms.

steps.title: Write with one borrowed chord
steps.setup: Create: 16 bars, verse and chorus, with one bVII or iv.
steps.done: Saved and played; the borrowed chord resolves.

shelf.title: Sweet Home Alabama
shelf.teaches: D-C-G: the I-bVII-IV Mixolydian loop; the riff

shelf.title: All Along the Watchtower
shelf.teaches: The i-bVII-bVI-bVII Aeolian loop

shelf.title: Hey Jude
shelf.teaches: Verse I-V7-I-IV; the coda I-bVII-IV-I

shelf.title: Creep
shelf.teaches: G-B-C-Cm: I-III-IV-iv, the major III and the minor iv

shelf.title: Don't Look Back in Anger
shelf.teaches: I-V-vi-iii-IV-I-ii-V and the iv (Fm) in the pre-chorus

shelf.title: Norwegian Wood
shelf.teaches: Mixolydian melody (b7) in 3/4; the bridge in the parallel minor

shelf.title: Here Comes the Sun
shelf.teaches: bVII-IV-I in the bridge; uneven bar groupings (11/8, 7/8)

shelf.title: Space Oddity
shelf.teaches: I-iii, IVmaj7-iii7, bVII and borrowed chords in the bridge

levels.test: Name every chord of two new songs that use bVII or iv; play one shelf song's melody and chords with the record; all twelve intervals ascending at 66%.

levels.title: Sevenths, ii-V-I and secondary dominants
levels.goal: Hear seventh qualities, ii-V-I, secondary dominants, inversions and a moving bass.
levels.adds: Ear: seventh qualities, ii-V-I, V/x, inversions, a moving bass. Harmony: sevenths on every degree, root motion round the circle, tonicisation, slash chords and line clichés.

steps.title: Seventh qualities
steps.setup: Chord qualities: major 7, dominant 7 and minor 7, then add half-diminished and diminished 7.
steps.done: 75% on all five, on two days.

steps.title: H9 Diatonic sevenths and the circle
steps.setup: Circle T-6, a key's chords up to four; T-7, the blank wheel; T-8, round the circle on your instrument.
steps.done: T-6 95% under 5 seconds, on two days; the blank wheel from memory; T-8 done.

steps.title: ii-V-I by ear
steps.setup: Progression dictation: I, ii and V as seventh chords.
steps.done: 75%, on two days.

steps.title: H10 Secondary dominants
steps.setup: Library reference, then Circle of fifths, Spot the secondary dominant: pick the secondary dominant (II7, III7, VI7, I7) in a written progression, or name the chord it leads to. A run is 20 progressions.

steps.title: Hear secondary dominants
steps.setup: Song loops, secondary dominants: V7/V, V7/vi, V7/ii and V7/IV inside short loops. They are not yet items in Chords in a key or Progression dictation.
steps.feeds: Hotel California, Georgia on My Mind

steps.title: Inversions
steps.setup: Inversions: root and first, then root, first and second, then sevenths.
steps.done: 80% on triads, then 66% on sevenths, on two days.

steps.title: Bass with inversions
steps.setup: Bass lines: lines through inversions.
steps.done: 75%, on two days.

steps.title: H11 Slash chords and line clichés

levels.title: Modes and chord-scales
levels.goal: Hear and name the modes, recognise modal vamps, sing a mode over a drone, and improvise with a chord-scale.
levels.adds: Ear: modes, modal vamps, singing modes. Harmony: modes by brightness, the characteristic note, chord-scale basics.

steps.title: Modes, bright side
steps.setup: Scales and modes: major, Lydian and Mixolydian.
steps.done: 80%, on two days.

steps.title: Modes, dark side
steps.setup: Scales and modes: natural minor, Dorian, Phrygian and Locrian, then add melodic minor.
steps.done: 66%, on two days.

steps.title: H12 Modes by brightness
steps.setup: Library reference and the circle's white-note modes (F C G D A E B), then Scales: all seven modes on C, brightest first.
steps.done: Name each mode's characteristic note; play all seven on one tonic, on two days.

steps.title: Modal vamps by ear
steps.setup: Song loops, modal vamps: i-IV (Dorian), I-bVII (Mixolydian), I-II (Lydian), i-bII (Phrygian) and i-bVI-bVII (Aeolian); then Jam, modal.

steps.title: Sing a mode over a drone
steps.setup: Ear, Scales, Sing it: Dorian and Mixolydian up and down from the tonic, within 35 cents. In Check only the tonic sounds; the tuner's drone is for practice.
steps.done: Dorian and Mixolydian up and down, 75% within 35 cents.

steps.title: H13 Chord-scale basics
steps.setup: Chord scales: the major ii-V-I, then the minor; Library chord-scale map.
steps.done: The chord-scale drill passed for both: 3 checked runs each at 66%, on two days.

steps.title: Improvise on a modal vamp
steps.setup: Jam in Check, modal, Chord tones on 1 and 3 (the game counts chord tones only). Call and response, Answer, judges landing on a chord tone.
steps.done: Three choruses, 75% of strong-beat notes chord or scale tones.

steps.title: Transcribe a modal melody
steps.setup: The shelf loop on a melody, compared with the score.
steps.done: 85% of notes and rhythms.

steps.title: Call and response in a mode
steps.setup: Call and response over the Dorian vamp: Echo first, then Answer. Checked runs of 6 turns.
steps.done: 12 answers, 75%.

levels.title: Song form and standards
levels.goal: Hear form in any recording, follow ii-V chains in major and minor, play guide-tone lines through a standard.
levels.adds: Ear: form on recordings, the minor ii-V, guide tones. Harmony: song forms, ii-V chains, turnarounds, backdoor, the rhythm-changes bridge.

steps.title: H14 Song form
steps.setup: Library reference: verse, pre-chorus, chorus, bridge; AABA, ABAC; 12 and 16-bar blues; 4 and 8-bar phrases.
steps.done: The form of 4 known songs written from memory.

steps.title: Label form on recordings
steps.setup: Learn by ear: mark every section boundary on a recording (Intro, Verse, Chorus, Bridge, A, B), then loop each section to check it. The app keeps your marks; it can't judge them.
steps.done: 4 songs, every boundary within a bar.

steps.title: H15 ii-V chains and turnarounds
steps.setup: Library reference; Jam in Check, Make the changes, with the ii-V-I and the minor ii-V-i in 4 keys, one run per key.
steps.done: Two choruses each, no lost place.

steps.title: Minor ii-V-i by ear
steps.setup: Progression dictation, minor: i, ii and V as seventh chords.
steps.done: 66%, on two days.

steps.title: Turnarounds and backdoor

levels.title: Short solos
levels.goal: Transcribe 12 to 24 bars of real solos, play them with the record, analyse them against the changes, and reuse the licks.
levels.adds: Ear: solos from recordings, licks in keys. Harmony: chord tones, tensions and approach notes as a soloist uses them.

steps.title: Sing the solo first
steps.setup: Learn by ear: loop the solo at 70% speed with the pitch kept, sing it, then at 100%.
steps.done: Sing 8 bars along with the record at full speed.

steps.title: Transcribe 4, then 8, then 12 bars
steps.setup: Learn by ear: loop a phrase at a time, play it back, then compare with the score in Song Studio. The check against the score (N3) is still to come.
steps.done: 85% of notes and rhythms per chunk.

steps.title: Play it with the record
steps.setup: Song Studio with the imported score, then with the record at 100%.
steps.done: Clean at 100% twice.

steps.title: Analyse the solo
steps.setup: Write each note's role over the chord (chord tone, tension, approach); check with Jam's tone roles.
steps.done: Every note labelled; two licks marked.

steps.title: Licks into keys
steps.setup: Phrases, Your licks: save two licks (Learn by ear, Save as a lick, or the first bars of a transcription), then take each through the keys.
steps.done: Each lick in 4 keys at the record's tempo.

steps.title: Use the licks
steps.setup: Jam over the solo's changes, with at least two of your licks per chorus.
steps.done: Three choruses kept.

steps.setup: Intervals, sing it: all twelve. Fine pitch to 25 cents is optional.
steps.done: 75% in the window, on two days.

levels.title: Reharmonise and the whole song
levels.goal: A whole lead sheet by ear, hear substitutions and modulations, reharmonise and write.
levels.adds: Ear: tritone subs, diminished passing chords, modulation. Harmony: diatonic substitution, tritone substitution, passing diminished chords, secondary ii-V, chromatic mediants, key changes.

steps.title: H16 Substitution
steps.setup: Library reference: iii and vi for I, ii for IV, the tritone sub (bII7), passing #i°7, secondary ii-V, backdoor.
steps.done: Each substitution played under a melody in C.

steps.title: Tritone sub vs V7
steps.setup: Song loops, tritone subs: ii-bII7-I against ii-V7-I, and the turnaround with bII7 in place of V7.

steps.title: Diminished passing chords
steps.setup: Chord qualities, the sevenths, judged on diminished 7. I-#i°7-ii-V is in Song loops, turnarounds.
steps.done: 75% on diminished 7, on two days.

steps.title: Hear a key change
steps.setup: Progression dictation, key changes: the old key is set, then a ii-V (later a plain V7 or a backdoor) takes it somewhere new. Where does it go: up a step, up a half step, to the relative, a third away; then the chords as numerals in the new key.

steps.title: Reharmonise a tune three ways
steps.setup: The Create piano roll (the reharmonisation sandbox, N10, is still to come): Amazing Grace or Happy Birthday with diatonic subs, then secondary dominants, then tritone subs and passing diminished chords.
steps.done: Three versions saved; melody notes on strong beats are chord tones or tensions.

steps.title: Original vs reharmonised version
steps.setup: Transcribe the chords of two versions of one song.
steps.done: Both chord charts right every bar; the substitutions labelled.
steps.feeds: Over the Rainbow, My Favorite Things

steps.title: A whole lead sheet by ear
steps.setup: Melody, chords and form of a whole song in Learn by ear, compared with the score. The check against the score (N3) is still to come.
steps.done: 85% of the melody, 85% of chord bars.

steps.title: Write and reharmonise your own tune
steps.setup: Create, then Record: 16 or 32 bars, then a reharmonised second chorus.
steps.done: A recorded take kept in the journal.

steps.title: Fine pitch (optional)
steps.setup: Fine pitch, the staircase, starting at 25 cents (warm up from 50). Judged on runs that start at 25 cents or finer.
steps.done: Threshold at or under 25 cents, on two days.
